acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: Playwright coverage API https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-coverage , monocart-reporter https://github.com/cenfun/monocart-reporter , Datadog Test Impact Analysis https://docs.datadoghq.com/tests/test_impact_analysis/ .

Gap: AFU-V1-021's coverage exclusion basis needs a coverage record with declared tier completeness, but no shipped adapter turns browser coverage into one. The template/component hop is UNKNOWN (V1-1162).

Proposal: map per-test V8 coverage to repository paths through source maps pinned to the build. Declare client-tier completeness only when every loaded script resolves; unresolved bundles stay UNKNOWN. The observed screen-to-module bindings can also confirm V1-1162 static anchors. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: Playwright per-test V8 coverage adapter producing AFU-V1-021 coverage records via pinned source maps
